name: WCAG 2.2 CSS Lint - Focus & Target Size
subtitle: Reads your stylesheet and names the success criterion each rule breaks, including the three WCAG 2.2 added that WCAG 2.1 linters never learned.
free: Lint the stylesheet you have open against all 14 rules, with the success criterion number, the failing line and the fix on every finding.
paid: Scan every stylesheet in the workspace in one pass and export the findings as a dated criterion-by-criterion evidence table (Markdown + CSV) you keep and attach to your accessibility statement.
need_key: This option needs a licence (WCAG 2.2 CSS Lint - Focus & Target Size).
